characteristics.name: Squadron Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a unique squadron during your activation, you may deal 1 damage to another friendly squad at distance 1 of the defender. If you do, you may change 1 die to any face.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per activation, while a friendly ship is attacking a ship, if another friendly ship is at close-medium range of the defender, the attacker may change 1 die to a face with any 1 icon (and no other icons.)

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text:
You must choose at least 2 types of command tokens for this card.
At the start of each Ship Phase, you may discard 1 command token from this card.  If you do, each enemy ship gains a raid token matching that command token.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: When a friendly ship or squadron is destroyed, you may choose 1 friendly ship or unique squadron at distance 1-5 of the destroyed ship or squadron.  If you do, the chosen ship or unique squadron may either ready 1 of its defense tokens or recove 1 of its discarded defense tokens and then exhaust that token.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of each Ship Phase, you may reveal and discard 1 command dial from this card.  If you do, until the end of the round, when a friendly ship spends only a matching command token to resolve a command, that ship resolves that command as if it had spent a dial and token of the same type instead.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per activation, while a friendly ship is attacking a ship, the attacker adds 1 black die to its attack pool for each raid token the defender has, to a maximum of 2 additional dice.

characteristics.name: Commander Ability
characteristics.$text:
While a friendly ship is attacking, if the defending hull zone has at least 1 shield remaining, the attacker may add 1 red die to its attack pool.
While a friendly ship is attacking a ship that has no shields remaining, after rolling attack dice, the attacker must cancel 1 attack die.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While defending, you may exhaust this card to spend 1 defense token that your opponent targeted with an [Accuracy] result.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: When you resolve the [Redirect] token effect, you can choose more than 1 hull zone to suffer damage, which may include a nonadjacent hull zone.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: After a squadron performs an attack against you, even if you are destroyed, you may discard this card to roll 4 blue dice.  That squadron suffers 1 damage for each [Hit] or [Crit] icon rolled.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Ship Phase, you may discard this card to discard up to 3 of your facedown damage cards.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
At the start of each Status Phase, you may recover 1 shield.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of each Ship Phase, you may choose 1 of your hull zones and mark it with a chaff token.  Until the end of the round, while a ship or squadron is attacking that hull zone, the attack is obstructed.  After the Status Phase, remove that chaff token.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While defending, you may exhaust this card and spend a readied defense token to resolve the [Salvo] defense effect instead of that token's effect.  You cannot resolve the [Salvo] defense effect more than once per attack.

characteristics.name: Defensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Medium or Large ship only.
While defending, after the attacker gathers dice, you may spend 1 [Brace] token.  If you do, choose and remove half of the dice in the attack pool, rounded down.

characteristics.name: Experimental Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: Before an enemy ship at distance 1-5 resolves the Determine Course step, you may exhaust this card to temporarily reduce its speed by 1 to a minimum of speed 0 until the end of the maneuver.

characteristics.name: Experimental Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: Before deploying fleets, place 1 grav well token anywhere in the play area.  When a ship deploys at distance 1-3 of a grav well token, its speed must be set to 0.

characteristics.name: Experimental Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While a friendly ship at distance 1-3 is defending at close range, during the Spend Defense Tokens step, you may exhaust this card to force the attacker to reroll up to 4 dice of your choice.

characteristics.name: Experimental Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: Before deploying fleets, place 1 grav shift token anywhere in the play area.  After deploying fleets, you may move each obstacle at distance 1-3 of that token to within distance 2 of that obstacle's current location.  Obstacles cannot overlap tokens, obstacles, or ships.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text:
While a friendly squadron with Bomber at distance 1-5 is attacking a ship, it may reroll 1 die.  
A squadron cannot resolve more than 1 "Bomber Command Center" card per attack.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, you may exhaust this card to choose an enemy ship at distance 1 - 3. Look at the top command dial assigned to that ship. Then you may either choose a new command on its top command dial or that ship gains 1 raid token of your choice that does not match its top command dial. If the chosen ship has no top command dial, it gains 1 raid token of your choice.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: After your Reveal Command Dial step, you may discard 1 command token from this ship to assign a matching token to another friendly ship at distance 1-5.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: While a squadron at distance 1-2 is attacking a squadron or defending against a squadron, the attack must be treated as obstructed.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: [Repair]:  Instead of spending engineering points, you may discard 1 damage card from 1 friendly ship at distance 1-2.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: After your Reveal Command Dial step, you may exhaust this card and discard any number of [concentrate fire] tokens from it to choose that many friendly ships at distance 1-5.  Assign each chosen ship a [concentrate fire] token.

characteristics.name: Fleet Support Ability
characteristics.$text: After your Reveal Command Dial step, you may exhaust this card and discard any number of [Repair] tokens from it to choose that many friendly ships at distance 1-5.  Assign each chosen ship a [Repair] token.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [Crit]:  Exhaust all of the defender's defense tokens.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [Crit]:  Choose and discard 1 command token from the defender.  If the defender does not have any command tokens, the defending hull zone loses 1 shield instead.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, you may spend 1 blue die to reroll any number of dice in your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a ship, each of your unspent blue [Accuracy] icons adds 1 damage to the damage total.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [Crit]:  Exhaust this card to force the defender to choose and discard 1 of its defense tokens.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [Crit]:  Choose and exhaust 1 of the defender's upgrade cards.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
The battery armaments for your left and right hull zones are increased by 1 blue die.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text: Blue [crit]:  Exhaust this card.  The defending hull zone and each adjacent hull zone loses 1 shield.

characteristics.name: Ion Cannons Ability
characteristics.$text:
Non-huge ship only.
While defending at close range or distance 1, during the Spend Defense Tokens step, you may force the attacker to reroll 1 die of your choice.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: Your squadron value is increased by 1.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a squadron at close range, you may reroll your [Crit] icons.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.
When you activate, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 enemy ship of your size class or smaller at distance 1-5.  That ship must spend a [Navigate] token or reduce its speed by 1 to a minimum of 1.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: While defending at distance 1, if the attacker is a squadron, you have counter 1.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: [Squadron]:  You can activate friendly squadrons at close-long range (instead of close-medium).

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Before deploying fleets, you may set aside a number of friendly squadrons up to your squadron value next to your ship card.
When you reveal a command, you may discard this card. If you do, place each squadron set aside with this card within distance 1 - 2 of you. Those squadrons cannot move during your activation.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Small or medium ship only.
When you activate, you may discard this card.  If you do, the blue dice in your battery armament can be used while attacking ships at close-long range until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Large ship only.  
When you overlap a ship of smaller size class (or are overlapped by a ship of a smaller size class), deal 1 fewer facedown damage cards to your ship.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.
Friendly Heavy squadrons at distance 1-2 prevent engaged squadrons from attacking ships.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: Before deploying fleets, you may discard this card to place a number of proximity mine tokens equal to half your engineering value, rounded down. You may place these tokens anywhere in the play area beyond distance 5 of enemy ships (and distance 1 of each other).

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: When a non-unique squadron with Swarm at distance 1-5 is destroyed, you may discard this card.  If you do, you may set that squadron's hull points to "2" and place that squadron, unengaged, at distance 1 with its activation slider toggled to the activated side.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Squadron Phase, when it is your fleet's turn to activate squadrons, you may exhaust this card to choose a number of unactivated, friendly squadrons at close-long range up to your squadron value.  This turn, activate each of those squadrons.  While attacking, each of those squadrons with AI are treated as if activated by a [Squadron] command.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Medium or Large ship only.
Flagship only.
Modification.
You gain 1 [Fleet Command] icon in your upgrade bar.
You cannot spend a command token to resolve a [Fleet Command] card's effect.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
While performing a non-[Salvo] attack against a ship at close-medium range, you may exhaust this card.  If you do, the defender gains 1 raid token of your choice.
While attacking a squadron, you may exhaust this card.  If you do, add 1 die of a color already in your attack pool to your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Offensive Retrofit Ability
characteristics.$text:
Treat each die in your anti-squadron armament as black.
While performing a [Salvo] attack, the black dice in your battery armamentt can be used at medium range and the blue dice in your battery armament can be used at long range.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may spend 1 command token to change that command to a [Navigate] or [Repair] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may spend 1 command token to change that command to a [Concentrate Fire] or [Squadron] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, after you roll your attack pool, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 defense token.  If that defense token is spent during this attack, discard that token.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a command, you may discard this card to gain 1 command token of your choice.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Command Phase, you may discard this card to discard all of your command dials.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Repair] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Squadron] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Navigate] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may change that command to a [Concentrate Fire] command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, if you overlapped an obstacle, you may discard this card instead of resolving the effects of overlapping that obstacle.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: During your activation, you can resolve your [Squadron] command after you execute a maneuver.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you reveal a command, you may discard this card to discard your top command dial.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you resolve the [Contain] defense effect, you can prevent the attacker from resolving any critical effects.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: While defending, during the Spend Defense Tokens step, when you spend a [Redirect] defense token, you may reduce the total damage from the attack by 1 instead of resolving that token's effect.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Ship Phase, you may discard this card to choose 2 different command tokens and place them on 2 different ships.  Then your opponent chooses 2 different command tokens you did not choose and places them on 2 different ships.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you spend only a [Repair]. [Navigate], or [Squadron] command token to resolve a command, you may exhaust this card.  If you do, resolve that command as if you had spent a dial of the same type instead.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text:
After deploying fleets, you may place 2 non-consecutive round tokens on this card.
During each round matching 1 of those tokens, while attacking a ship, you may reroll up to 3 dice.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a command, you may choose another friendly ship at distance 1-5.  If you do, discard any number of command tokens from that ship, this card, or both to gain 1 matching command token for each discarded token.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: [Repair]:  You may spend up to 2 shields from any of your hull zones or any 1 hull zone on another friendly ship at distance 1-5 to gain twice that many additional engineering points.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: While a friendly unactivated squadron is at distance 1-3, it gains Counter 3 or, if it has the printed Counter keyword, gains an additional Counter 1.  After it performs a Counter attack, toggle its activation slider to the activated side.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text:
When you reveal a command, you may place a matching command token on this card.  If you do, gain a command token of your choice.
During the Command Phase, if you have a command token on this card, you must choose that command on each command dial that is to be assigned to you and show those dials to your opponent.  Then discard that command token.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When you reveal a command, you may place a matching command token on this card.  Then, if you have at least 1 [Navigate]. 1 [Squadron, 1 [Concentrate Fire], and 1 [Repair] command token on this card, you may gain 1 additional command dial of your choice.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: When a friendly ship at distance 1 - 5 resolves a [Squadron] command, you may discard 1 [Squadron] token from this card. If you do, that friendly ship may activate 1 additional squadron during that command.

characteristics.name: Officer Ability
characteristics.$text: During the activation of a friendly ship at distance 1-5 of you, you may exhaust this card to discard 1 raid token from an enemy ship at distance 1-5 of you. If you do that friendly ship may gain 1 command token of any type.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: Black [Crit]:  Exhaust this card.  Each hull zone adjacent to the defending hull zone suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
The battery armaments for your front hull zone is increased by 2 black die.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: Black [Crit]:  Exhaust this card to deal 1 faceup damage card to the defender.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a squadron, you may spend 1 black die with a [Crit] icon to toggle its activation slider to the activated side.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
The battery armaments for your left and right hull zones are increased by 1 black die.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking at close range, you may discard this card to add 2 black dice to your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text: Black [Crit]:  If the defender is a ship, choose 1 other ship or squadron at close range of the defender.  That ship or squadron suffers damage equal to half of the total number of black [Hit] icons in your attack pool, rounded up.

characteristics.name: Ordnance Ability
characteristics.$text:
Medium or large ship only.  
At the end of your Attack Step, you may exhaust this card and choose 1 of your hull zones.  Then, perform an attack from that hull zone with an anti-squadron armament of 1 black die, even if you have already attacked from that zone this round.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: [Navigate]: If you spent a [Navigate] Token, once during this maneuver, when you would change your speed, you may instead increase 1 yaw value by 1.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text:
[Navigate]:  After you execute a maneuver, you may exhaust this card to execute a speed-1 maneuver.
After you execute a maneuver, if you overlapped a ship, exhaust this card.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: [Repair]:  You may spend up to 2 engineering points to move that many shields from your ship to a friendly ship at distance 1-5.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, you may select a number of unengaged friendly squadrons up to your squadron value at close-medium range.  Those squadrons may move up to distance 1.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you are dealt a faceup damage card with the Crew trait, you may discard this card to discard that damage card.

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text: [Repair]:  You may treat the maximum shield values of your right and left hull zones as increased by 1 when you recover or move shields to those zones.  If you do, the number of shields in each of those zones cannot exceed a maximum of "4".

characteristics.name: Support Team Ability
characteristics.$text:
Droid only.  
[Repair]:  You may exhaust this card.  If you do:  
Flip any number of your faceup damage cards with the CREW trait facedown.  
Discarding facedown damage cards costs 1 fewer engineering point.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When you activate, you may exhaust this card and spend 1 or more of your defense tokens to choose up to that many defense tokens on friendly ships at distance 1-3 and ready those defense tokens.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Before you suffer damage from an attack, if the defending hull zone has at least 1 shield remaining, you may exhaust this card to reduce the total damage by 1.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
The battery armaments for your left and right hull zones are increased by 1 red die.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
While attacking, you may change 1 die face with a [Hit] or [Crit] icon to a face with an [Accuracy] icon.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text: [Crit]:  The first 2 damage cards dealt to the defender by this attack are dealt faceup.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, if the defender spends a [Redirect] token, it cannot suffer more than 1 damage on each hull zone other than the defending hull zone when it resolves the [Redirect] defense token.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, the [Brace] defense effect cannot reduce the damage total by more than 1 unless it is the only defense token spent by the defender during the attack.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, you may exhaust this card and spend 1 [Evade] defense token to change 1 red die to a face with a [Crit] icon or 2 [Hit] icons.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.
You cannot attack more than once per round.
While attacking a ship, add 1 red die to your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification. 
While attacking, if at least 1 red die face has an [Accuracy] icon, add 1 red die set to the [Accuracy] icon to your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification. 
The battery armaments for your front and rear hull zones are increased by 1 red die.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
While attacking, you may exhaust this card to add 1 red die to your attack pool.  If you do, choose and cancel 1 attack die.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.
While attacking a ship with a higher speed than yours, you may add 1 blue die to your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a squadron, you may reroll 1 red die in your attack pool.  While attacking a ship, if you have the bombard tag, you may reroll 1 red die in your attack pool. During your activation, while attacking the first squadron during an attack, you may exhaust this card to add 2 dice of any color to your attack pool. If you do, you cannot declare additional squadron targets for this attack.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text:
Modification.  
When you reveal a command, you may exhaust this card to choose 1 of your hull zones and mark it with a focus token.  While attacking a ship from that hull zone, add 1 die of any color from an adjacent hull zone's armament to your attack pool.  While attacking from adjacent hull zones, remove 1 die from your attack pool.  When you ready this card, remove that focus token.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a squadron, before you gather dice, if the defender is not engaged with a friendly squadron, you may replace all of the blue dice in your anti-squadron armament with red dice.

characteristics.name: Turbolasers Ability
characteristics.$text: While performing a [Salvo] attack, you may change 1 die to a face with a [Crit] icon.

characteristics.name: Weapons Team Ability
characteristics.$text:
[Concentrate Fire]:  The next attack you perform this activation can be performed from this hull zone.  
Each of your hull zones cannot target the same ship or squadron more than once during your activation.

characteristics.name: Weapons Team Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, you may exhaust this card and spend 1 die to change 1 of your dice to a face with an [Accuracy] icon.

characteristics.name: Weapons Team Ability
characteristics.$text: [Squadron]:  The anti-squadron armament of each squadron that you activate is increased by 1 blue die until the end of its activation.

characteristics.name: Weapons Team Ability
characteristics.$text: After attacking a squadron, you may deal 1 damage to a friendly squadron engaged with the defender.  If you do, the defender suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Weapons Team Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, you may reroll up to 2 black dice.

characteristics.name: Weapons Team Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking, you may exhaust this card to reroll all dice in your attack pool.

characteristics.name: Weapons Team Ability
characteristics.$text: During the Resolve Damage step, you may exhaust this card to resolve 1 additional critical effect.  You cannot resolve the same critical effect twice.

characteristics.$text: At the start of the Ship Phase, you may discard this card or spend a [Concentrate Fire] token. If you do, until the end of the round, while each friendly ship is attacking a ship, it may change 1 die to a face with 1 [Hit] icon and no other icons.

characteristics.name: Fleet Command Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Ship Phase, you may discard this card or spend a [Navigate] token. If you do, until the end of the round, each friendly ship may increase the last yaw value of its current speed by 1 during its Determine Course step.

characteristics.name: Fleet Command Ability
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the Squadron Phase, friendly squadrons with Adept gain Grit until the end of the phase.
When a friendly squadron with Adept is destroyed, you may choose 1 enemy ship at distance 1-2 of that squadron.  If you do, that ship gains 1 raid token of your choice.

characteristics.name: Fleet Command Ability
characteristics.$text:
When an enemy ship declares you as the target of a non-[Salvo] attack, if this card is readied, the attacker gains a raid token of its choice, if able.
When an enemy ship at close range reveals a command, it may discard a [Squadron] dial to exhaust this card.
While defending, if this card is exhausted, you cannot spend more than 1 defense token.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Command Phase or Ship Phase, you may discard a [Redirect] defense token to move shields to 1 of your hull zones.  If you do, the number of shields in that zone cannot exceed a maximum of "6".  You cannot recover shields in that zone while it is greater than its maximum shield value.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text:
When you are deployed, you must choose 1 of each type of command token for this card.
Your command value is increased to 4.
You can be assigned more than 1 of each type of command token.
When you reveal a command, you may discard all of the tokens from this card to gain them.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: While attacking a ship at medium-long range, if this is your first attack during your activation, you may add 2 blue dice to your attack pool.  If you do, you cannot attack again during this activation.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: You gain 1 additional [Defensive Retrofit] icon in your upgrade bar.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text:
While deploying fleets, if you are in the play area, when you would deploy a squadron with Swarm, you may set that squadron aside next to your ship card instead.  You may set aside up to 5 squadrons in this way.
[Squadron]:  Choose any number of squadrons set aside with this card. Then place them within distance 1 - 3 of you. During your activation, those squadrons cannot move and, if they have AI, may increase their AI value by 1.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text:
Treat your rear hull zone's printed battery armament as 3 red dice.
The battery armament of your left and right hull zones are each increased by 1 black die and decreased by 1 blue die.
